fit_reason: This listing is for the aluminum bunk trailer only. The Sea Ray shown in two photos is just what the trailer used to carry and is not for sale, so there is no whole boat or vehicle here to detail.
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Quick Load aluminum bunk trailer. We detail boats and vehicles, so a trailer on its own isn't something we work on. If you're ever selling the Sea Ray or another boat, we'd be glad to come out and give you a quote for a gelcoat polish or pre-sale detail.
